Gratar was known for housing the biggest factory in the solar system. The whole facility was controlled by an AI made by a fantastic inventor last seen on Etern. As of recent, legend has it that the AI on Gratar has gone rogue.

> Moon Map

Loading scripts


> Moon Info

POPULATION: Killed.

CONDITIONS: Warm, dry dirt terrain, supports plant life such as Fabaceae.

FAUNA: A thriving Avian ecosystem, creatures support agressive behaviour.

> Environment

Gratar has several dirt mountains that extrude from a vast ocean below. Multiple waterfalls can also be seen falling down from the taller mountains around the exterior. The terrain itself is covered in bushes, grass, and trees. Bridges and ladders with lights nearby can be used for navigation and traversal.

Several concrete structures and parts of the factory are visibile on the exterior, some of which are either the main entrance or fire exits. The main entrance is on top of the hill in front of the ship and across the bridge. Two fire exits are visibile to the northeast and southwest from the ship as well. The last regular fire exit is at the top of the hill to the left of the ship and requires either the cruiser (not recommended), two extension ladders, or a jetpack to reach from the exterior.

Exterior Ambience

> Weather

Gratar can experience Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, or Forsaken weather by default.

When Gratar is Flooded, large trees and branches will be present on the exterior, mainly in the middle of the moon. This does not affect any existing pathways or the moveable bridge, but does create new potential pathways for players to use.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Interior Content and G. A. R. Y.

In the interior, the lights are red, the rogue AI, G. A. R. Y., can be heard in the background, and the AI will play various voicelines. These voicelines can be used as a rough indicator for how much time has past, as most of them play roughly every 45-60 seconds, or every 1-1.5 hours of in-game time, while a player is inside the interior. Some additional lines are played when various things happen within the interior, such as the lights turning on or off.

Interior Ambience and Voicelines

Broken Bridge

A broken bridge to the left of the main entrance can be pushed. Pushing the bridge will move it towards the right side of the ship temporarily before it falls into the water below, making it a one-time use. Players can stand on and place scrap on the bridge, so it can be useful for quickly getting scrap from the main entrance back to the ship or avoiding entities later in the day.

Fire Exits

Two lone fire exits can be found within the interior that lead to an area on the exterior where both of these fire exits are connected by a bridge. A natural fog surrounds this area when on the bridge or approaching it, but the bridge can be seen a little behind and to the right of the ship. This area is accessible via jetpack.

Special Room

A blue fire exit can also be found to the side of the main entrance that leads to a fabrication machine. Players can deposit Ingredient Items into the machine to craft Untampered operating panels, Triangulation devices, Double barrel shotguns, Shotgun shells, Adrenaline-stims, Health-stims, Pulatrum spore emitters, Boomboxes, Advanced flashlights, Fog reducers, Radar boosters, Action figures, Weed killer, De-weed, Pesticide sprinklers, Fabricated keys, and Single-barrel shotguns here. Note that there is a conversion rate for ingredients to resources (e.g., 1 Steel ingot equals 3 Steel), which is listed in the Ingredient Items section mentioned above. Any ingredients deposited into the machine will be saved even if players are fired and resources are shared with the machine on Galetry.

G. A. R. Y.'s Announcement

Text ⁠
ALERT! Facility wide decontamination imminent.
Gratar thanks you for your service.
May tomorrow be a brighter day.

G. A. R. Y. makes an announcement on the exterior that it will soon perform a facility-wide decontamination at 09:00pm. At around 09:20pm, multiple explosions will occur at various areas, such as the main entrance and fire exits, that can also be heard within the interior. These explosions deal no damage to the player.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Inserting the Gratar videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of Acidir, Assurance, Atlantica, Cosmocos, Etern, Infernis, Polarus, or Repress into the projector in Galetry. At least two tapes are supposed to spawn within the interior of Repress.
Alternatively, logging Cunningham's visit that randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of Cosmocos or Polarus.

Unlocks

Atlantica: Atlantica videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
Utril: Utril videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.

> Lore

G. A. R. Y., the AI, was originally created by the scientist on Etern with the intention of finding the location of Cosmocos after it teleported. However, the AI was incapable of reciting the full location, either because the location was encrypted or because the AI was malfunctioning. It then got sold to be used by the company located on Gratar.

Accident Logs / Fatality Reports

Accident logs can randomly spawn as scrap within the interior. They are workplace accident reports logged by G. A. R. Y. that a manager is viewing. These accidents gradually become more dangerous, causing more and more fatalities, until it is revealed that G. A. R. Y. itself caused thousands of "workplace accidents" in a single day by powering up the turrets to kill everyone.

Cunningham's Visit

Additionally, Cunningham's visit can randomly spawn as scrap within the interior. It plays the conversation between Cunningham and G. A. R. Y. and Cunningham was able to trick G. A. R. Y. into revealing Cosmocos's location.

Text ⁠
G.A.R.Y. : Unregistered personel found within the factory.

G.A.R.Y. : Alert, all employees must die.

Cunningham : We don't work here.

G.A.R.Y. : Alert, all intruders must die.

Cunningham : Aren't intruders supposed to be arrested?

G.A.R.Y. : Alert, this is.. correct.

Cunningham : Arest us.

G.A.R.Y. : Alert, all intruders are now under arrest. Calling management for questioning.

Cunningham : Management has arrived.

G.A.R.Y. : I killed management, following code 5, all intruders must die.

Cunningham : UH I'M M NEW!

G.A.R.Y. : Alert, order overwritten, awaiting new orders.

Cunningham : Tell me the hidden code of finding Cosmocos.

G.A.R.Y. : The hidden code is,

[DATA CORRUPTED]

Cunningham : That was easier than expected.

G.A.R.Y. : Alert, no records of new management has been found, following code 5, all intruders must die.

Cunningham : OH MOTHERF-

Gratar Videotape

If the player finds Gratar's videotape as random scrap on other moons and inserts it into the projector in Galetry, Cunningham will describe her initial impressions of Gratar. She originally rated Gratar as a Hazard Level C prior to her conversation with G. A. R. Y.
This videotape can be found on Atlantica, Assurance, Acidir, Cosmocos, Etern, Infernis, Polarus, and Repress. At least two tapes are supposed to be guaranteed to spawn within the interior of Repress.

Text ⁠
Tape 5, Gratar.

This is Captain Commander Cunningham.
It hasn’t been long since we got here.
It already appears to be a nice breath of fresh air compared what we have been through before.

The view is undeniably.. Stunning and the local wildlife has yet to try and kill us.
We will be going in soon to have a chat with this AI before we take off again.

Thus far I rate Gratar a low C.
Cunningham, signing off.

> Trivia

  • If a player waits in the interior for about 560 seconds, or the majority of the day, G. A. R . Y. will announce that the "the fourth letter is capital Q". This is part of the Where is Comsocos? puzzle, which was the old method for downloading and playing Cosmocos. The puzzle now leads to a different reward, but it is unknown if it is still completable legitimately in the Obscurity update as the Recovered secret log is currently not part of the scrap table for Asteroid-13.
  • G. A. R. Y. has a voiceline within the interior that sings to the tune of the sea shanty "Drunken Sailor". This voiceline normally plays past midnight and when the ship automatically leaves a moon, so it can only be heard in-game by changing the day speed.
